verdict.rationale: Vercel's Git-based deployment model covers the full loop for code-defined automations such as Workflows and eve agents. Every push is versioned and gets a preview environment for review, with collaborator comments and Vercel Agent code review. Production can be instantly reverted to a prior deployment or released gradually and rolled back, with rollback webhook events. The evidence frames this at the deployment level rather than for automations specifically, so it applies to automations only by implication. Missing for 10: explicit docs on versioning and rollback of Workflows/agent automations themselves, review/diff of automation runs across versions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
